scripts.clean: rimraf test-output/reports/allure-results && rimraf test-output/reports/allure-report && rimraf test-output/logs/logs.log
scripts.test: npm run clean & playwright test & npm run report
scripts.test:chrome: npm run clean & cross-env BROWSER=chrome playwright test & npm run report
scripts.test:firefox: npm run clean & cross-env BROWSER=firefox playwright test & npm run report
scripts.test:edge: npm run clean & cross-env BROWSER=edge playwright test & npm run report
scripts.test:smoke: npm run clean & playwright test --grep @smoke & npm run report
scripts.test:regression: npm run clean & playwright test --grep @regression & npm run report
